_about: voices.json · v0.1 · 2026-10-02. The voice for each role: 'piper:<model name>' (a .onnx in the voices folder) or 'kokoro:<voice>' (kokoro-v1.0 ONNX). Change a role here and restart speech_server.py; tts/samples/README.md lists the candidates. The three roles should sound different from each other.
